thread:
toni: FYI during a live onboarding demo the js sdk (fncall + jsonMode) turned array-of-object results into strings and broke our sample zod validation.

liam: can you paste a tiny example of raw vs received?

toni: raw model output:
```json
{"rows":[{"k":"a","v":1},{"k":"b","v":2}]}
```
what hit the validator:
```json
{"rows":["{\"k\":\"a\",\"v\":1}","{\"k\":\"b\",\"v\":2}"]}
```

marie: that's double stringification of array elements. which sdk and helper?

toni: js-sdk 0.10.x, only when using the function-call helper path with JSON_MODE enabled. Python sample didn't reproduce.

liam: suspect sanitize helper collapses unknown values to primitives and assumes arrays are lists of primitives. missing JSON.parse of array items.

marie: parsing heuristics are risky for free text, but for onboarding we can add an opt-in flag SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_ITEMS that tries JSON.parse for string elements starting with "{" or "[" and under 10k chars. default off.

toni: will enable in demo env so new users don't get blocked. please add telemetry event sanitizer.array_item_parse with result success/fail and sdk_version.

liam: I'll open PR in js-sdk with the opt-in flag, tests for mixed arrays and top-level-string preserved, and the telemetry. Link in thread when ready.

marie: small docs note in onboarding README explaining tradeoffs. plan to evaluate telemetry after 14 days and consider flipping default.

toni: thanks — demo unblocked. closing loop. :thumbsup:
